worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.summary: Hurling a large egg with maximum force: a hit is the heaviest single strike in the family and leaves a slick patch at the landing point; even a miss that hits the ground leaves the slick, and any non-ally standing in it slips. The heavy choice is heavier and wider but slower and looser; the straight choice is faster and more accurate but lighter.
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.use.0: Hurl the heaviest single physical strike at a thick target
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.use.1: Turn the landing point into a small slick that forces opponents to walk around it
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.use.2: Lob the egg over cover on a high arc
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.description.0: Deals %1$s physical damage to a living target, with a %2$s block egg radius.
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.description.1: The egg flies at %1$s blocks/tick and reaches %2$s blocks with ±%3$s° spread (the translation of the native 75 accuracy).
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.description.2: The throw falls at %1$s blocks/tick^2; the landing point spreads a %2$s block slick of %3$s shell shards that lasts %4$s, and any non-ally standing in it slips.
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.heavy.on: Heavy: power x1.2, a wider slick that lasts longer, at the cost of spread x1.35, throw speed x0.85, wind-up +4 ticks and cooldown +8 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.heavy.off: Straight: spread x0.8, a faster throw and a shorter wind-up, at the cost of power x0.85 and a smaller slick.
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.growth.0: From level %1$s the egg power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.growth.1: From level %1$s the egg power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.eggbomb.preference.hea: On: power x1.2, a wider slick that lasts longer, at the cost of spread x1.35, throw speed x0.85, wind-up +4 ticks and cooldown +8 ticks. Off (straight): spread x0.8, a faster throw and a shorter wind-up, at the cost of power x0.85 and a smaller slick.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: a target standing still and not running ranks higher, and airborne targets drop to last (native 75 accuracy makes a moving target easy to miss); off: all targets score the same.
world_combat.move.eggbomb.text.miss: The egg broke at your feet
